title: hemionitis flexuosa
intro: Hemionitis flexuosa, commonly known as the flexible hemionitis or flexible polypody, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis flexuosa include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as promoting wound healing and skin regeneration. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
